summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Kukdi Personal OS. 18/18 backend pytest tests pass covering Home (adaptive state + override), Conversation (LLM Claude Sonnet 4.6 flow, candidate memories, confirm/dismiss), Memory (CRUD, archive, candidates), Dream Offer (overview + companies + prep CRUD + stage cycle), People (seed + CRUD), Calendar (events + LLM ask), Knowledge (list + search + CRUD). Frontend Playwright checks confirm Home renders adaptive greeting/heading, state-switcher opens state-menu and applies state overrides (heading changes to 'Exam mode'), Home conversation pill navigates to /talk and Kukdi replies via LLM (editorial reply visible), Dream Offer stage cycles (interviewing -> offer) persist, add-company modal opens, prep status dots clickable, Memory search filters, People/Calendar/Nav all have working data-testids. Calendar Ask Kukdi returned a valid natural-language answer. All 4 seeded companies (Google, Microsoft, Adobe, MakeMyTrip) and all 4 seeded people (Ananya, Rohan Mehta, Prof. Nair, Mom) present.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/dream.py update_company/update_prep/update_person/update_memory apply timestamps even when body is empty (no 400 short-circuit like memory). Minor: PATCH with empty payload still bumps updated. Not breaking.
routes/calendar.py update_event does not update the 'updated' timestamp (no such field on events, so acceptable).
conversation.py: candidates and messages inserted sequentially without transaction — acceptable for single-user MVP.
All routes correctly project out MongoDB _id. UUID-based ids used consistently. Env vars used properly (no hardcoded URLs). Pydantic validation at edges. Good.
seed_data_creation: No new seeds created; auto-seed on startup verified working via listed seeded companies/people/memories.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var to run pytest: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.6) calls take ~3-6s; keep timeouts generous. Candidate memory creation depends on LLM judgement — use unambiguous 'remember this' phrasing to force candidates.
